summary: Opens an always-on-top Document Picture-in-Picture (PiP) window containing the embedded Strudel REPL sample page with direct GPU context sharing, CodeMirror live coding, real-time audio output streaming, bi-directional BroadcastChannel pattern sync, and live pattern telemetry

ports.name: Open REPL Window
ports.text: Trigger button to open or focus the Strudel REPL pop-up window.

ports.name: Close REPL Window
ports.text: Trigger button to close the Strudel REPL pop-up window.

ports.name: Play / Stop
ports.text: Checkbox toggle to start (play) or stop (hush) Strudel pattern evaluation.

ports.name: Auto Open On Load
ports.text: When enabled, automatically opens the pop-up window when the patch or op loads.

ports.name: Width
ports.text: Pixel width of the pop-up window.

ports.name: Height
ports.text: Pixel height of the pop-up window.

ports.name: Window Title
ports.text: Title string for the pop-up window.

ports.name: Strudel CSS Variables
ports.text: CSS string containing :root CSS variable overrides for the Strudel editor theme.

ports.name: Pattern Code
ports.text: Strudel JS pattern code string. Changes to this port broadcast live to the pop-up REPL via BroadcastChannel API.

ports.name: Volume
ports.text: Volume scaling factor (0.0 to 1.0+) for the streamed WebAudio output node.

ports.name: Popup Sound Output
ports.text: Toggle local speaker sound playback in the pop-up window. When disabled, pop-up speakers are muted while the WebAudio output stream to Cables continues.

ports.name: Is Open
ports.text: Outputs true when the pop-up window is active and open.

ports.name: Window Object
ports.text: Outputs the JavaScript Window reference of the opened pop-up window.

ports.name: Canvas Element
ports.text: Outputs the HTMLCanvasElement reference from the pop-up window.

ports.name: Audio Node
ports.text: Outputs the Cables WebAudio GainNode connected to the live audio stream from the pop-up window.

ports.name: Current Pattern
ports.text: Outputs the active Strudel pattern code string currently loaded and live-coded in the pop-up REPL.

ports.name: Is Playing
ports.text: Outputs true when the Strudel pattern scheduler is actively playing.

ports.name: Active Notes
ports.text: Outputs an array of objects representing currently sounding note events ([{ note, midi, sound, gain, velocity, duration }, ...]).

ports.name: Active MIDI Notes
ports.text: Outputs an array of active MIDI note numbers (e.g. [60, 64, 67]).

ports.name: Active Note Names
ports.text: Outputs an array of active note name strings (e.g. ["C4", "E4", "G4"]).

ports.name: Active Note Count
ports.text: Outputs the integer count of currently active sounding notes.

ports.name: On Note Event
ports.text: Trigger fired whenever a new note/hap event is played in Strudel.

ports.name: CPS
ports.text: Outputs the current Cycles Per Second value of the Strudel pattern.

ports.name: BPM
ports.text: Outputs the calculated Beats Per Minute (CPS * 120).

ports.name: Cycle Progress
ports.text: Outputs normalized 0.0 to 1.0 progress within the active cycle.

ports.name: Current Cycle
ports.text: Outputs the total elapsed cycle timestamp.

ports.name: On Cycle
ports.text: Trigger fired on every integer cycle boundary (downbeat).

ports.name: Last Event
ports.text: Outputs the complete JSON object of the last triggered hap/note event.

ports.name: Last Sound
ports.text: Outputs the sample or synth sound name of the last triggered event.

ports.name: Error
ports.text: Outputs any active evaluation or runtime error message string.
